name: meta-skills
description: Disposable meta-skills that build a project's agent harness, then get removed.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: The required set: enough to take any project from no harness to a working one, including the removal skill.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Design description and visual language for projects with a user-facing frontend. Install on top of core.

plugins.name: python
plugins.description: Trusted defaults and doc URLs for Python targets: docstring and comment conventions, testing setup, toolchain choices, and locating a package's documentation. Install on top of core.

plugins.name: machine-learning
plugins.description: Documentation entry points, project scaffolds, and GPU-image discovery for ML projects; -docs skills inform only, the rest declare their opinionated defaults. Install on top of core.

plugins.name: data-science
plugins.description: Documentation entry points for data-analysis and scientific-computing domains, plus opinionated project scaffolds that declare their defaults. Install on top of core.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Platform-side conventions for GitHub-hosted projects: collaboration flow and templates, CI gates mirroring local checks, guardrails, community health files, planning and releases — capabilities always fetched live from the GitHub docs. Install on top of core.

plugins.name: gitlab
plugins.description: Platform-side conventions for GitLab-hosted projects: collaboration flow and templates, CI gates mirroring local checks, guardrails, community health files, planning and releases — capabilities always fetched live from the GitLab docs, respecting instance version and tier. Install on top of core.
